long_biography.plain_text:
Following the death of Doğuş founder Ayhan Şahenk in 2001, Filiz Şahenk assumed responsibility for the family group's branded-fashion and tourism interests. She handled partnerships with international luxury labels and led the tourism division as it expanded into marina operations, including the opening of D-Marin Turgutreis. That work established her as an active operator as well as an heir to the family enterprise.

Şahenk remains a substantial shareholder in Doğuş Holding, whose activities now extend across automotive, hospitality and retail, property, energy, media and technology. Alongside the commercial portfolio, she is deputy chair of the Ayhan Şahenk Foundation, continuing the family's programmes in education, health, culture, environmental work and sport.
